three_distinct_claims.claim: Task-conditioned FiLM improves multi-domain segmentation over an identical unconditioned backbone
BARR benefit router and post-safety modules improve on the GlobalMedFiLM backbone
three_distinct_claims.required_control: router-off and safety-off arms against the same backbone
three_distinct_claims.reason: no ablation arm exists; integrated vs backbone = +0.0028 (0.8379 vs 0.8351), single seed, within noise; no safety metric exists

three_distinct_claims.claim: The proposed model outperforms standard baselines under a common frozen protocol
three_distinct_claims.reason: EXT-03 divergent in five parameters; AS-08 UNRESOLVED

decisive_finding_that_option_C_is_silent.statement: The GlobalMedFiLM checkpoint contains no router and no safety tensors, so a FiLM-off control cannot produce evidence about modules absent from the model being controlled.
decisive_finding_that_option_C_is_silent.inference_note: Reading tensor shapes from a state dict is metadata inspection, not model inference.

fiLM_off_can_establish: for one fixed protocol/seed/dataset/eval rule: whether removing task conditioning changes the selected VAL808 equal-domain macro Dice, and by how much
fiLM_off_cannot_establish: BARR superiority (router and safety modules absent from the controlled model)
safety, robustness or failure-mode behaviour (no safety metric exists; Dice carries no safety semantics)
router benefit (B_phi not in the checkpoint)
generalisation (VAL808 is the selection set; selection-contaminated)
that FiLM is the only difference (architecture, protocol and seed treatment differ from every baseline)
safety_statement: No safety claim of any kind is supported by any experiment currently in this repository.

parameter_count_definitions.total_parameters: sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) - every parameter tensor in the module tree, whether or not it receives gradients
parameter_count_definitions.trainable_parameters: sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad) - the subset the optimiser updates
parameter_count_definitions.key_principle: Freezing does not reduce total parameters. requires_grad=False changes what the optimiser updates; it does not remove the tensor from the model, the graph, or the state dict.

F1_freeze_at_init.description: film_layers and task_embedding present and frozen at zero-initialised values
F1_freeze_at_init.identity_property: gamma == 0 and beta == 0 for every task, so F_hat = (1+gamma)*F + beta = F exactly

F2_remove_modules.description: film_layers and task_embedding deleted from the model

claims_that_must_not_be_made.claim: The frozen control has 2.58% fewer parameters
claims_that_must_not_be_made.why_false: False for F1. Total is unchanged; only trainable falls by 2.58%.

claims_that_must_not_be_made.claim: The frozen control is a smaller model
claims_that_must_not_be_made.why_false: False for F1. Same model, smaller optimised subset.

claims_that_must_not_be_made.claim: F1 and F2 are equivalent controls
claims_that_must_not_be_made.why_false: They differ in total capacity and model class; only F1 supports an equal-capacity claim.

identity_property_scope.holds_for: a freshly initialised model whose FiLM output projection is zero-initialised and whose FiLM parameters are then frozen
identity_property_scope.does_not_hold_for: the trained GlobalMedFiLM checkpoint - after training gamma and beta are non-zero, which is the point of training them
identity_property_scope.measured_evidence_on_trained_ckpt: decoder1 gamma positive at every domain (+0.235/+0.434/+0.455/+0.311); bridge gamma separates domains into two clusters; beta mean_abs 0.036-0.187 across sites
identity_property_scope.consequence: The control is not 'GlobalMedFiLM with FiLM zeroed'. It is a from-scratch retrain with conditioning held at identity, and any comparison is from-scratch.

Protocol frozen before launch and identical between control and treatment
